result.scope: Recorded native bytes and accounting only; not a visual quality certificate.
result.precall_scope: Exact saved input equality and filesystem timestamp consistency with one-second clock precision; not exhaustive tool-history or native invocation-order certification. Prompt comparison ignores terminal LF only. Existing call-input-actual.json is an explicit filename alias; no records are recreated or timestamps changed.

current_validate_d_exact_criteria.manifest_scope: Enumerates initial, repair-1 and repair-2 for C02/P01/H02. Initial absence is missing; optional absent repair stages do not themselves prevent PASS. This audit independently confirmed all nine closed stages.
current_validate_d_exact_criteria.native_provenance: Distinct tool-original/native-original/final paths; all bytes SHA256 identical; four manifest hash fields equal; PNG signature, IHDR width/height, recorded dimensions and relative ratio error <=1%. This audit also independently checks PNG chunk CRCs and IEND termination.
current_validate_d_exact_criteria.prompt_input: Saved call-input JSON object equals manifest actual input; fallback only to existing call-input-actual.json when call-input.json is absent. Supported keys only, opaque background false, complete original copy items as literal prompt substrings, saved prompt equality ignoring terminal LF only. Initials omit both reference keys; repairs forbid conversation history and any supplied local reference must be own immediate prior final. Fresh regeneration is accepted.
current_validate_d_exact_criteria.timing: Timezone-bearing recorded intervals with end>=start. Both prompt and selected saved-input filesystem mtimes < recorded start +1 second, reflecting whole-second clock precision. Mutable filesystem metadata is not exhaustive invocation history certification.
current_validate_d_exact_criteria.accounting: Pinned C/R3 ledger SHA256, declared boundaries 9/41/42/76, frozenD six-file hashes/sizes, no more than two own repair manifests, cap checks and exact D ledger manifest records.
current_validate_d_exact_criteria.selection: Exactly three D roles, selected native SHA256/path/role/stage matches production and manifest hash/dimensions.
current_validate_d_exact_criteria.not_checked_by_validate_d: Visual copy/readability/style/quality; PNG CRCs; independent reviewer identity or tool history; selected14 review composition, QA derivative view-time hashes, exact D9 closure as a general requirement, recorded concurrency. This audit covers metadata closure/concurrency/static selected14 binding separately.

limitations: No quality PASS is derived from metadata. Visible exact copy/readability/style and all numerical visual gates require closed independent reports.
